How to read this page
Year / Half / Qtr / Month / Week / Day = chart on which the zone is made (YIT, HYIT, QIT, MIT, WIT, DIT).
DBR, RBR = demand (buy) zones, RBD, DBD = supply (sell) zones.
Freshness: Fresh = price never came back to the zone, Tested 1× / 2×+ = price has returned that many times.
Score: 7+ = Type 1 (set and forget), 5–6 = Type 2/3 (needs confirmation), below 5 = no trade. Grade A+ = 7+, A = 6, B = 5, C = below 5. The number after each option is how many setups it shows right now.
Entry = just beyond the proximal line, Stop loss = just beyond the distal line. Tap a card for the chart, your Qty (set capital and risk there) and full details.
Location (tap it) = where price sits between the nearest fresh demand and supply on the higher timeframe: Low favours buying, High favours selling. Trend (tap it) = 50 SMA slope on the middle timeframe: Up = buy, Down = sell, Sideways = ignore. Execution = the zone itself (trade score, tap it or the card). ★ Best = all three are ✓ and score 7+.
Room ✓ = no opposite zone within 2x the stop-loss distance. Price in zone = price is at the zone now (first touch).
W ✓ / M ✓ = a fresh same-side zone on that higher timeframe overlaps this zone or is within 1% (confluence).
